52    private function resolveBookRoot(): string
53    {
54        $configBookRoot = config('app.book_root');
55        $envRoot = env('BOOK_STORAGE_PATH') ?: (getenv('BOOK_STORAGE_PATH') ?: null);
56        $diskRoot = config('filesystems.disks.books.root');
57
58        $candidates = array_values(array_filter([
59            is_string($configBookRoot) ? trim($configBookRoot) : '',
60            is_string($envRoot) ? trim($envRoot) : '',
61            is_string($diskRoot) ? trim($diskRoot) : '',
62        ]));
63
64        foreach ($candidates as $candidate) {
65            if ($candidate !== '' && is_dir($candidate)) {
66                return rtrim((string) (realpath($candidate) ?: $candidate), '/');
67            }
68        }
69
70        $fallback = $candidates[0] ?? '';
71        if ($fallback === '') {
72            return '';
73        }
74
75        return rtrim((string) (realpath($fallback) ?: $fallback), '/');
76    }

78    /**
79     * Import a book from any source
80     *
81     * @param array $bookData Normalized book metadata
82     * @param array $options Import options
83     * @return array Result with status and book
84     */
85    public function importBook(array $bookData, array $options = []): array
86    {
87        $this->bookRoot = $this->resolveBookRoot();
88
89        $dryRun = $options['dry_run'] ?? false;
90        $force = $options['force'] ?? false;
91        $sourcePath = $options['source_path'] ?? null;
92        $duplicateAction = $options['duplicate_action'] ?? null;
93
94        Log::debug('UnifiedBookImporter: importBook called', [
95            'bookData' => $bookData,
96            'options' => $options,
97            'bookRoot' => $this->bookRoot,
98        ]);
99
100        try {
101            // Check for existing book
102            $existingBook = $this->findExistingBook($bookData);
103
104            if ($existingBook && !$force && !$duplicateAction) {
105                return [
106                    'status' => 'skipped',
107                    'reason' => 'already_exists',
108                    'book' => $existingBook,
109                ];
110            }
111
112            if ($dryRun) {
113                return [
114                    'status' => $existingBook ? 'would_update' : 'would_import',
115                    'book' => $existingBook,
116                ];
117            }
118
119            // Determine destination path
120            $destPath = $this->prepareDestinationPath($bookData, $options);
121
122            // Handle file operations
123            if ($sourcePath) {
124                $copiedFiles = $this->handleFileOperations(
125                    $sourcePath,
126                    $destPath,
127                    $bookData,
128                    $duplicateAction
129                );
130            } else {
131                $copiedFiles = [];
132            }
133
134            // Find cover image
135            $coverImage = $this->findOrCopyCoverImage($destPath, $sourcePath, $copiedFiles);
136            if ($coverImage) {
137                $bookData['cover_image'] = $coverImage;
138            }
139
140            // Create or update book record
141            DB::beginTransaction();
142            try {
143                if ($existingBook) {
144                    $book = $this->updateBook($existingBook, $bookData, $destPath, $copiedFiles);
145                    $status = 'updated';
146                } else {
147                    $book = $this->createBook($bookData, $destPath, $copiedFiles);
148                    $status = 'imported';
149                }
150
151                // Create relationships
152                $this->createRelationships($book, $bookData);
153
154                DB::commit();
155
156                return [
157                    'status' => $status,
158                    'book' => $book,
159                ];
160            } catch (\Exception $e) {
161                DB::rollBack();
162                throw $e;
163            }
164        } catch (\Exception $e) {
165            Log::error('Book import failed', [
166                'book_data' => $bookData,
167                'error' => $e->getMessage(),
168                'trace' => $e->getTraceAsString(),
169            ]);
170
171            return [
172                'status' => 'error',
173                'error' => $e->getMessage(),
174            ];
175        }
176    }

178    /**
179     * Find existing book by various criteria
180     */
181    private function findExistingBook(array $bookData): ?Book
182    {
183        // Try by ASIN first
184        if (!empty($bookData['asin'])) {
185            $book = Book::where('asin', $bookData['asin'])->first();
186            if ($book) {
187                return $book;
188            }
189        }
190
191        // Try by directory path
192        if (!empty($bookData['directory_path'])) {
193            $book = Book::where('directory_path', $bookData['directory_path'])->first();
194            if ($book) {
195                return $book;
196            }
197        }
198
199        // Try by title and author
200        if (!empty($bookData['title'])) {
201            $query = Book::where('title', $bookData['title']);
202
203            if (!empty($bookData['author'])) {
204                $authorNames = is_array($bookData['author']) ? $bookData['author'] : [$bookData['author']];
205                $query->whereHas('authors', function ($q) use ($authorNames) {
206                    $q->whereIn('name', $authorNames);
207                });
208            }
209
210            $book = $query->first();
211            if ($book) {
212                return $book;
213            }
214
215            // Fallback: if we couldn't match by author relationship (or authors are missing),
216            // but there is exactly one book with this title, treat it as the existing record.
217            $titleMatches = Book::where('title', $bookData['title'])->limit(2)->get();
218            if ($titleMatches->count() === 1) {
219                return $titleMatches->first();
220            }
221        }
222
223        return null;
224    }

267    /**
268     * Generate directory path based on book metadata
269     */
270    private function generateDirectoryPath(array $bookData): string
271    {
272        Log::debug('UnifiedBookImporter: generateDirectoryPath called', [
273            'bookData' => $bookData,
274        ]);
275
276        if ($this->genreMapper === null) {
277            try {
278                $this->genreMapper = app(GenreMappingService::class);
279            } catch (\Throwable) {
280                $this->genreMapper = null;
281            }
282        }
283
284        // Map genre if we have genre mapper
285        $genre = 'General Fiction';
286        if (!empty($bookData['genre'])) {
287            $genreValue = $bookData['genre'];
288            if (is_array($genreValue)) {
289                $genreValue = $genreValue[0] ?? '';
290            }
291
292            if ($this->genreMapper) {
293                $genre = $this->genreMapper->mapToPrimaryGenre($genreValue);
294            } else {
295                $genreParts = is_array($genreValue) ? $genreValue : explode(':', (string) $genreValue);
296                $genre = trim($genreParts[0]);
297            }
298        }
299
300        $genre = $this->sanitizePath($genre);
301
302        $authorValue = $bookData['author'] ?? 'Unknown Author';
303        if (is_array($authorValue)) {
304            $authorValue = $authorValue[0] ?? 'Unknown Author';
305        }
306        $author = $this->sanitizePath((string) $authorValue);
307
308        $titleValue = $bookData['title_short'] ?? $bookData['title'] ?? 'Unknown Title';
309        if (is_array($titleValue)) {
310            $titleValue = $titleValue[0] ?? 'Unknown Title';
311        }
312        $title = $this->sanitizePath((string) $titleValue);
313
314        // If part of series, organize by series
315        if (!empty($bookData['series_name']) || !empty($bookData['series'])) {
316            $seriesName = $bookData['series_name'] ?? $bookData['series'];
317            $series = $this->sanitizePath($seriesName);
318            $sequence = $bookData['series_sequence'] ?? $bookData['series_number'] ?? '';
319
320            // Add sequence number prefix if available
321            if ($sequence) {
322                $title = str_pad($sequence, 2, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT) . ' ' . $title;
323            }
324
325            $path = "{$genre}/{$author}/{$series}/{$title}";
326
327            Log::debug('UnifiedBookImporter: Generated series path', [
328                'genre' => $genre,
329                'author' => $author,
330                'series' => $series,
331                'title' => $title,
332                'sequence' => $sequence,
333                'path' => $path,
334            ]);
335
336            return $path;
337        }
338
339        $path = "{$genre}/{$author}/{$title}";
340
341        Log::debug('UnifiedBookImporter: Generated non-series path', [
342            'genre' => $genre,
343            'author' => $author,
344            'title' => $title,
345            'path' => $path,
346        ]);
347
348        return $path;
349    }

351    /**
352     * Sanitize path component
353     */
354    private function sanitizePath(string $path): string
355    {
356        // Remove invalid characters
357        $path = preg_replace('/[<>:"|?*]/', '', $path);
358        // Remove control characters
359        $path = preg_replace('/[\x00-\x1F\x7F]/', '', $path);
360        // Trim
361        $path = trim($path);
362        // Remove leading/trailing dots
363        $path = trim($path, '.');
364
365        return $path;
366    }

368    /**
369     * Handle file operations (copy/move)
370     */
371    private function handleFileOperations(
372        string $sourcePath,
373        string $destPath,
374        array $bookData,
375        ?string $duplicateAction
376    ): array {
377        $fullDestPath = $this->bookRoot . '/' . $destPath;
378
379        Log::debug('UnifiedBookImporter: handleFileOperations START', [
380            'sourcePath' => $sourcePath,
381            'destPath' => $destPath,
382            'fullDestPath' => $fullDestPath,
383            'bookRoot' => $this->bookRoot,
384            'is_dir' => is_dir($sourcePath),
385            'is_file' => is_file($sourcePath),
386        ]);
387
388        // Create destination directory
389        if (!File::exists($fullDestPath)) {
390            Log::debug('UnifiedBookImporter: Creating destination directory', [
391                'path' => $fullDestPath,
392            ]);
393            File::makeDirectory($fullDestPath, 0755, true);
394        } else {
395            Log::debug('UnifiedBookImporter: Destination directory already exists', [
396                'path' => $fullDestPath,
397            ]);
398        }
399
400        $copiedFiles = [];
401
402        // Handle duplicate action for audio files
403        if ($duplicateAction === 'replace') {
404            // Move existing audio files to trash before replacing
405            $existingAudioFiles = glob($fullDestPath . '/*.{m4b,m4a,mp3}', GLOB_BRACE);
406            foreach ($existingAudioFiles as $existingFile) {
407                $trashResult = $this->sourceTrashService->movePathToTrash(
408                    $existingFile,
409                    'replaced_during_import',
410                    [
411                        'destination' => $fullDestPath,
412                        'action' => 'replace',
413                        'original_filename' => basename($existingFile),
414                    ]
415                );
416                if (!$trashResult) {
417                    Log::warning('Failed to move file to trash during replace', [
418                        'file' => $existingFile,
419                    ]);
420                }
421            }
422        }
423
424        // Copy files
425        if (is_dir($sourcePath)) {
426            $files = File::files($sourcePath);
427        } else {
428            $files = [new \SplFileInfo($sourcePath)];
429        }
430
431        Log::debug('UnifiedBookImporter: Found files to copy', [
432            'fileCount' => count($files),
433            'files' => array_map(fn ($f) => $f->getPathname(), $files),
434        ]);
435
436        foreach ($files as $file) {
437            $filename = $file->getFilename();
438            $destFile = $fullDestPath . '/' . $filename;
439            $ext = strtolower($file->getExtension());
440
441            Log::debug('UnifiedBookImporter: Processing file', [
442                'file' => $file->getPathname(),
443                'filename' => $filename,
444                'destFile' => $destFile,
445            ]);
446
447            // Skip audio files if merge mode and file exists
448            if (
449                $duplicateAction === 'merge' &&
450                in_array($ext, ['m4b', 'm4a', 'mp3']) &&
451                file_exists($destFile)
452            ) {
453                continue;
454            }
455
456            // Copy file
457            if (File::copy($file->getPathname(), $destFile)) {
458                $copiedFiles[] = $filename;
459                chmod($destFile, 0664);
460                Log::debug('UnifiedBookImporter: File copied successfully', [
461                    'from' => $file->getPathname(),
462                    'to' => $destFile,
463                ]);
464            } else {
465                Log::error('UnifiedBookImporter: Failed to copy file', [
466                    'from' => $file->getPathname(),
467                    'to' => $destFile,
468                ]);
469            }
470        }
471
472        Log::debug('UnifiedBookImporter: File operations complete', [
473            'copiedFiles' => $copiedFiles,
474        ]);
475
476        return $copiedFiles;
477    }

479    /**
480     * Find or copy cover image
481     */
482    private function findOrCopyCoverImage(string $destPath, ?string $sourcePath, array $copiedFiles): ?string
483    {
484        // Check if cover was already copied
485        foreach ($copiedFiles as $file) {
486            $ext = strtolower(pathinfo($file, PATHINFO_EXTENSION));
487            if (in_array($ext, ['jpg', 'jpeg', 'png', 'gif', 'webp'])) {
488                if (stripos($file, 'cover') !== false) {
489                    return trim($destPath, '/') . '/' . ltrim($file, '/');
490                }
491            }
492        }
493
494        // Use first image as fallback
495        foreach ($copiedFiles as $file) {
496            $ext = strtolower(pathinfo($file, PATHINFO_EXTENSION));
497            if (in_array($ext, ['jpg', 'jpeg', 'png', 'gif', 'webp'])) {
498                return trim($destPath, '/') . '/' . ltrim($file, '/');
499            }
500        }
501
502        // Try to find in destination directory
503        [$coverImage, $coverCandidates] = $this->findCoverImageCandidate($destPath);
504        return $coverImage;
505    }

531    /**
532     * Update existing book record
533     */
534    private function updateBook(Book $book, array $bookData, string $destPath, array $copiedFiles): Book
535    {
536        $duration = $this->parseDuration($bookData);
537        $totalSize = $this->calculateTotalSize($destPath, $copiedFiles);
538
539        // Only update directory_path if it's different from the current one
540        // This prevents creating nested directories during reimports
541        $updateData = [
542            'description' => strip_tags($bookData['description'] ?? $bookData['summary'] ?? $book->description),
543            'duration' => $duration ?: $book->duration,
544            'audio_file_count' => count(array_filter($copiedFiles, fn ($f) => preg_match('/\.(m4b|m4a|mp3)$/i', $f))) ?: $book->audio_file_count,
545            'total_size' => $totalSize ?: $book->total_size,
546            'cover_image' => $bookData['cover_image'] ?? $book->cover_image,
547            'asin' => $bookData['asin'] ?? $bookData['product_id'] ?? $book->asin,
548            'release_date' => $bookData['release_date'] ?? $book->release_date,
549            'publisher' => $bookData['publisher'] ?? $book->publisher,
550            'language' => $bookData['language'] ?? $book->language,
551            'abridged' => isset($bookData['abridged']) ? ($bookData['abridged'] === 'true') : $book->abridged,
552        ];
553
554        // Only update directory_path if it's different from the current one
555        if ($book->directory_path !== $destPath) {
556            $updateData['directory_path'] = $destPath;
557        }
558
559        $book->update($updateData);
560
561        return $book;
562    }

564    /**
565     * Create book relationships (authors, narrators, genres, series)
566     */
567    private function createRelationships(Book $book, array $bookData): void
568    {
569        // Authors
570        if (!empty($bookData['author'])) {
571            $authorNames = is_array($bookData['author']) ? $bookData['author'] : explode(',', $bookData['author']);
572
573            $authorIds = [];
574            foreach ($authorNames as $authorName) {
575                $authorName = trim($authorName);
576                if ($authorName) {
577                    $author = Author::firstOrCreate(['name' => $authorName]);
578                    $authorIds[] = $author->id;
579                }
580            }
581            $book->authors()->sync($authorIds);
582        }
583
584        // Narrators
585        if (!empty($bookData['narrated_by']) || !empty($bookData['narrator'])) {
586            $narratorField = $bookData['narrated_by'] ?? $bookData['narrator'];
587            $narratorNames = is_array($narratorField) ? $narratorField : explode(',', $narratorField);
588
589            $narratorIds = [];
590            foreach ($narratorNames as $narratorName) {
591                $narratorName = trim($narratorName);
592                if ($narratorName) {
593                    $narrator = Narrator::firstOrCreate(['name' => $narratorName]);
594                    $narratorIds[] = $narrator->id;
595                }
596            }
597            $book->narrators()->sync($narratorIds);
598        }
599
600        // Genres with primary/secondary support
601        if (!empty($bookData['genre'])) {
602            $allGenres = $this->extractGenres($bookData['genre']);
603
604            $genreData = [];
605            foreach ($allGenres as $index => $genreName) {
606                $genreName = trim($genreName);
607                if ($genreName) {
608                    $genre = Genre::firstOrCreate(['name' => $genreName]);
609                    $genreData[$genre->id] = ['is_primary' => ($index === 0)];
610                }
611            }
612            $book->genres()->sync($genreData);
613        }
614
615        // Series
616        if (!empty($bookData['series_name']) || !empty($bookData['series'])) {
617            $seriesName = $bookData['series_name'] ?? $bookData['series'];
618            Log::debug('UnifiedBookImporter::createRelationships - Series assignment', [
619                'book_id' => $book->id,
620                'book_title' => $book->title,
621                'seriesName' => $seriesName,
622                'bookData_series_name' => $bookData['series_name'] ?? null,
623                'bookData_series' => $bookData['series'] ?? null,
624            ]);
625            $series = Series::firstOrCreate(['name' => $seriesName]);
626            Log::debug('UnifiedBookImporter::createRelationships - Series found/created', [
627                'book_id' => $book->id,
628                'series_id' => $series->id,
629                'series_name' => $series->name,
630            ]);
631            $seriesNumber = $bookData['series_sequence'] ?? $bookData['series_number'] ?? null;
632
633            $book->series()->sync([
634                $series->id => [
635                    'series_number' => $seriesNumber,
636                    'created_at' => now(),
637                    'updated_at' => now(),
638                ],
639            ]);
640        }
641    }

643    /**
644     * Extract genres from various formats
645     */
646    private function extractGenres($genreData): array
647    {
648        if (is_array($genreData)) {
649            return $genreData;
650        }
651
652        if (is_string($genreData)) {
653            // Handle colon-separated genres (OpenAudible format)
654            if (str_contains($genreData, ':')) {
655                return array_map('trim', explode(':', $genreData));
656            }
657
658            // Handle comma-separated genres
659            if (str_contains($genreData, ',')) {
660                return array_map('trim', explode(',', $genreData));
661            }
662
663            return [$genreData];
664        }
665
666        return [];
667    }
668
669    /**
670     * Parse duration from various formats
671     */
672    private function parseDuration(array $bookData): ?int
673    {
674        if (!empty($bookData['seconds'])) {
675            return (int) $bookData['seconds'];
676        }
677
678        if (!empty($bookData['duration'])) {
679            // Parse HH:MM:SS format
680            if (is_string($bookData['duration']) && str_contains($bookData['duration'], ':')) {
681                $parts = explode(':', $bookData['duration']);
682                if (count($parts) === 3) {
683                    return ($parts[0] * 3600) + ($parts[1] * 60) + $parts[2];
684                }
685            }
686
687            // Already in seconds
688            if (is_numeric($bookData['duration'])) {
689                return (int) $bookData['duration'];
690            }
691        }
692
693        return null;
694    }

696    /**
697     * Calculate total size of files
698     */
699    private function calculateTotalSize(string $destPath, array $copiedFiles): int
700    {
701        $totalSize = 0;
702        $fullPath = $this->bookRoot . '/' . $destPath;
703
704        foreach ($copiedFiles as $file) {
705            $filePath = $fullPath . '/' . $file;
706            if (file_exists($filePath)) {
707                $totalSize += filesize($filePath);
708            }
709        }
710
711        return $totalSize;
712    }
713}
